data.name: Slayer's Brand
data.description: When using this judgment, the kinslayer gains the ability to brand undead creatures with positive energy. To do so, she must make a successful melee touch attack against the undead creature. This attack deals an amount of positive energy damage equal to 1d6 + %1, and burns her personal symbol into the undead creature's flesh, bone, or even its incorporeal form. From that point onward, the kinslayer can sense the existence of the branded creature as if it were the target of a locate creature spell (caster level %2). A slayer's brand lasts until the undead creature is destroyed or until the kinslayer uses this ability on another creature.|KinslayerSlayersBrandDamage|KinslayerSlayersBrandLVL
